name: Frozen Key

pages.text: Defeat Cornelia and use the key on a Frozen Chest; the key is consumed.

pages.title: Source
pages.text: Captain Cornelia’s ghost has the Frozen Key in its loot table. A normal Maze Captain provides the horn that summons Cornelia, rather than replacing that victory.

pages.title: Unlocking
pages.text: Hold the key and interact with a Frozen Chest deep in the Ice Maze. One key is consumed; the frozen block becomes an ordinary chest with its own loot. An ordinary chest or another block is not this target.

pages.title: Contents
pages.text: Contents include Rune of the Storm along with other Frozen Chest loot. Open the transformed chest and take its contents; the key is not returned.
